descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name meaning 'Yahweh will lend' or 'Yah forgets not', borne by several Levitical and priestly figures in Chronicles and Ezra. The name appears in variant spellings — Yishshiyyah and Yishshiyyahu — but all refer to the same proper noun across different individuals. All grammatical forms (nominative, with conjunction and-Yishshiyyah) are syntactic variants, not semantic distinctions. Multilingual renderings confirm a single lexical identity: eng 'Yishshiyah', spa 'Ishiya/Yishiyah', hin 'yishshiyyah' (यिश्शिय्याह), arb 'Yishshiyya' (يِشِّيَّا), kor 'Isiya' (이시야), swa 'Ishiya'.
